| Undated is a book, not a guess (76) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (260) |

| Book addresses are stable across a rebuild (176) | book addresses are stable across a rebuild (720) |
| Filters change membership and nothing else (182) | a filter changes membership without moving a shelf (731) |

| Hiding a shelf hides it, and never deletes it (240) | a hidden shelf keeps its definition and its books (993); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (2497); hiding every shelf offers a way back rather than an empty room (1011) |
| The reader (252) | a wikilink in a book goes to that note in this book, this shelf, or the nearest (2437); a tag book's cover carries no hash, and every other place it is named keeps it (2915); a hovered spine shows one peek, big enough to read, and short labels stand upright (2858); the date index is layered: years over months over days, each only where it separates (2261); a click off the book puts it down, and a click on it does not (2547); a wide table scrolls inside the page and never widens the book (2200); clicking a spine opens a book on the note it names (2244); the index tabs cut the book the way the book is ordered (625); the reader's index tabs stay countable on the biggest book (2317); the contents scroll to the current row after a tab, Previous and a ribbon (2332); previous and next walk the book and stop at its ends (2412); also shelved in moves to another book and keeps the note (2497); previous collection walks back, and Alt+Left does the same (2528); escape closes the reader and leaves the shelf where it was (2591) |
| The reading table survives (352) | a saved reading place re-resolves after its own book is gone (2646) |
| The builder previews the truth (363) | the builder previews the shelf it would actually save (2661); a saved shelf gets a stable id and joins the library (2680) |
| Metadata is declared, never inferred (374) | parent tag inclusion is a setting, and it changes the answer (2701); people come from the property alone, never from prose (2788) |
